taskDefinition.name: Azure Notification Template Send
taskDefinition.author: support@kineticdata.com
taskDefinition.description: Builds an email from a Kinetic notification template (snippets, replacement values, dates, inline images, and attachments) and sends it through Microsoft Graph.

parameter.label: Error Handling
parameter.tooltip: Determine what to return if an error is encountered.

parameter.label: Space Slug
parameter.tooltip: Slug of the space containing the notification templates. Leave blank to use the handler's space_slug property.

parameter.label: Recipient Json Object
parameter.tooltip: A JSON object such as {"smtpaddress":{"to":"to@example.com","cc":"cc@example.com","bcc":"bcc@example.com"},"language":"en","region":"","email notifications":"yes"}, or an email address.

parameter.label: Notification Template Name
parameter.tooltip: Name of an Active notification template.

parameter.label: Replacement Values
parameter.tooltip: JSON object of replacement values, e.g. {"values":{...},"form":{...},"vars":{...}}. ${key('name')} in the template is replaced with the value at key, name.

parameter.label: Submission Id
parameter.tooltip: Id of the submission whose attachment fields are referenced by the template's Attachments field.

parameter.label: From (Override)
parameter.tooltip: Sender mailbox to use instead of the handler's configured from_address. Leave blank to use the configured address.
